title: Cohort inventory, analysis units, and independence families
content_description: Defines cohort composition, analysis roles, sample subsets, and non-independence boundaries.
supported_claim: Defines cohort composition and analysis-unit boundaries for interpreting overlap and evidence independence.
interpretation_boundary: The cohort inventory alone is not biological validation; overlapping TCGA subsets and GSE53625 subseries are not independent.

title: TCGA-ESCC multi-assay sample map and analysis sets
content_description: Documents assay availability and locked patient subsets.
supported_claim: Defines the locked TCGA patient sets used by each analysis module.
interpretation_boundary: All subsets belong to one overlapping TCGA discovery family.

title: TCGA-ESCC driver candidate screen and patient-level event matrix
content_description: Reports the driver screen, patient event calls, and quality controls.
supported_claim: Supports prioritization of recurrent driver candidates for downstream state analyses.
interpretation_boundary: Driver priority is hypothesis-generating, not causal or therapeutically actionable.

title: Somatic mutation and copy-number association details
analysis_unit: Gene, event, patient, and event pair
content_description: Reports mutation recurrence, copy-number dosage, clusters, and event-pair summaries.
supported_claim: Supports descriptive mutation, copy-number, and dosage relationships within TCGA-ESCC.
interpretation_boundary: Correlated encodings from the same TCGA patients are not separate validation families.

title: MOFA factor, pathway, and clinical annotation results
analysis_unit: Patient, factor, feature, pathway, and clinical variable
content_description: Reports factor variance, scores, weights, pathway annotation, quality controls, and clinical associations.
supported_claim: Supports latent-state annotation and pathway and clinical characterization.
interpretation_boundary: Latent factors and annotations do not by themselves prove mechanism.

title: Patient-state heterogeneity clustering results
content_description: Reports cluster evaluation, pathway contrasts, and patient assignments.
supported_claim: Supports descriptive patient-state heterogeneity within TCGA-ESCC.
interpretation_boundary: Cluster labels are descriptive summaries from the TCGA discovery cohort, not independently validated subtypes.

title: Representation-overlap-audited driver-state association analysis
content_description: Reports original associations, network edges, factor alignment, stability, and retained associations from the pre-specified event-view-deletion analysis.
supported_claim: Supports within-TCGA event-state associations that persist in pre-specified mutation/CNV omission sensitivity analyses.
interpretation_boundary: Event-view deletion reduces representation circularity within TCGA but is not independent validation or causal proof.

title: Locked ECMS projection, calibration, and factor associations
analysis_unit: Patient, ECMS probability, factor, and pathway
content_description: Documents projection, calibration, quality checks, and continuous state associations.
supported_claim: Supports ECMS-contextualized continuous-state associations in the locked TCGA anchor.
interpretation_boundary: The 78-patient anchor is a TCGA subset; the 16 projected extensions are excluded from primary association inference.

title: Cao et al. paired cross-layer calibration
analysis_unit: Pre-specified candidate within paired tumor and non-tumor specimens
content_description: Reports candidate-restricted WGBS, RNA, protein, and cross-layer calibration.
interpretation_boundary: Coverage is candidate- and layer-dependent; missing protein data are not negative evidence.

title: PR001876 targeted metabolomics calibration
content_description: Reports inventory, quality control, differential results, candidates, and sensitivities.
supported_claim: Supports orthogonal metabolic-module calibration under the stated design limitations.
interpretation_boundary: The design is unpaired; overlap is unresolved and absolute concentration claims are not allowed.

title: PRJNA766558 paired 16S rRNA microbiome analysis
analysis_unit: ASV, genus, and paired FFPE specimen
content_description: Reports denoising, taxonomy, diversity, paired tests, and pipeline sensitivity.
supported_claim: Supports paired FFPE microbiome contrasts under the stated compositional and quality-control limitations.
interpretation_boundary: No public negative control was identified; results are compositional and FFPE-specific.

title: Integrated evidence summary, axes, and candidate network
analysis_unit: Evidence item, candidate, edge, and integrated axis
content_description: Reports evidence tiers, the integrated evidence table, candidates, edges, axes, and module synthesis.
supported_claim: Supports integrated ranking of hypotheses and cross-layer axes.
interpretation_boundary: Integration summarizes public-data convergence; it does not convert association into mechanism.

title: External RNA-proxy and endpoint transportability calibration
analysis_unit: Patient, repeated CV run, factor, cohort, and endpoint model
content_description: Reports frozen proxy definitions, internal fidelity, patient-level scores, survival models, ECMS incremental analyses, and exploratory pathological-response associations.
supported_claim: Supports RNA-proxy transportability assessment and external endpoint calibration, not full MOFA or event-level replication.
interpretation_boundary: Internal proxy fidelity does not constitute external biological replication; GSE53622/24 are one family, ECMS shares the 314-gene representation, and response analyses are exploratory.
